problem_text:
A logistics coordinator must assign a set of fragile components to identical reinforced crates for air shipment. The components are as follows:

* Component Alpha: mass 50 kg
* Component Beta: mass 46 kg
* Component Gamma: mass 35 kg
* Component Delta: mass 52 kg
* Component Epsilon: mass 34 kg
* Component Zeta: mass 37 kg
* Component Eta: mass 52 kg
* Component Theta: mass 31 kg
* Component Iota: mass 52 kg
* Component Kappa: mass 52 kg
* Component Lambda: mass 41 kg
* Component Mu: mass 30 kg
* Component Nu: mass 44 kg
* Component Xi: mass 53 kg
* Component Omicron: mass 34 kg

Each reinforced crate has a certified maximum safe load capacity of 100 kg. The coordinator must determine an arrangement to place all components into crates, with the primary objective of minimizing the total number of crates utilized. Every component must be allocated to precisely one crate, and the aggregate mass loaded into any given crate must not surpass its designated weight limit.
